components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Confident action for saving or syncing.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 38px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid var(--rail); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--rail); color: var(--rail-ink); font: 600 13px "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease-out, border-color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; } .ds-button-primary:hover { border-color: var(--rail-hover); background: var(--rail-hover); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:active { background: var(--rail-hover); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Quiet, clearly labeled field for search and settings.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 5px; color: var(--ink); font: 600 13px "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); font: 400 15px/1.5 "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--form-placeholder); opacity: 1; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent); outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Workspace Navigation
components.description: Current section in the desktop navy rail.
components.html: My work
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: flex; min-height: 42px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--rail-hover); color: var(--rail-ink); font: 600 14px "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: var(--rail-hover); color: var(--surface); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--signal-amber); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Work Item State
components.description: Compact label for a work item's current state.
components.css: .ds-state-tag { display: inline-block; max-width: 100%; overflow: hidden; padding: 3px 7px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--state-bg); color: var(--state-ink); font: 400 12px/1.4 "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-state-tag:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Attention Board Row
components.description: A stable, compact row showing recorded age and last-changed date without implying a due date.
components.html: 37 daysReview the next work itemExample projectActiveOct 1, 2026
components.css: .ds-attention-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 84px minmax(210px, 1.7fr) minmax(140px, 1fr) minmax(85px, .7fr) 112px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 47px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--board-rule); color: var(--rail-ink); font: 400 13px/1.5 "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-attention-row:hover { background: var(--board-hover); } .ds-attention-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--signal-amber); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-age { color: var(--signal-amber); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-age::before { display: inline-block; width: 7px; height: 7px; margin-right: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--attention); content: ""; } .ds-title { overflow: hidden; font-weight: 600; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-project, .ds-changed { overflow: hidden; color: var(--rail-secondary); text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

narrative.overview:
Mission Hall helps its owner scan personally relevant Azure DevOps work and spot items that have gone unchanged. The screen keeps familiar navigation, search, filters, and a complete work-item table; the visual direction borrows a departure board's disciplined columns, tabular figures, and clear signal colors without turning the interface into a flight simulator.

The signature move is the dark attention board: age, work item, project, state, and last-changed date line up in a stable row. Amber makes elapsed time easy to find, while a restrained red signal marks stale work. These are real elapsed days and changed dates, never due dates or schedules that the data does not contain.
keyCharacteristics: Deep navy navigation and attention board, framed by a cool, light workspace.
Crisp aligned columns and tabular figures for quick comparison.
Red and amber carry attention meaning; blue marks interaction.

rules.name: The Real Schedule Rule
rules.body: Show only recorded work-item facts: elapsed time since last change and its actual date. Never invent due dates, departure times, or workflow order.

dos: Do show items needing attention before the full work list.
Do keep data dense but readable with aligned columns and ruled separators.
Do use tabular figures for counts, dates, and elapsed time.
Do keep Azure DevOps read-only and local-storage language factual.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and the labeled mobile table rows.
donts: Don't invent due dates, departures, schedules, or workflow sequences.
Don't use red or amber as general navigation and action colors.
Don't bury the work list beneath large metric panels.
Don't imply that GitHub integration is already available.
Don't add decorative shadows, gradients, or heavily rounded card grids.
